ValidationRule.description: Prevent the converted status from being manually selected from the dropdown
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( ISCHANGED(Status), ISNEW() ), ISPICKVAL( Status , "Converted" ), IsConverted = False )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: To convert a lead:(Lightning users) Select the "Converted" and "Select Converted Status" buttons within the lead's status path. (Classic users) Select the "Convert" button.
